_comment: Always-watching HUD aesthetic — Iron Man / JARVIS inspired. Reference: Jayse Hansen's MCU interface work + F-15/F-18 HUD design language. Cold electric teal-cyan on void black, arc reactor gold secondary. Military aviation HUD. Refs/vigil/ holds extracted frames from the Iron Man (2008) 'Hot Rod Red' workshop scene that informed the 2026-05-23 retune.

data._comment: Cyan-dominant ladder per the same 'large-category-mustn't-saturate' lesson hackers learned (memory/feedback_hackers_cyan_dominant). cat[0..3] stay in the cyan/teal family so 2-4 category treemaps don't kick orange or red into 30%-of-viewport bars. Gold/orange/red push to cat[4..5] for rare highlight only. Reference: refs/vigil/ Iron Man Hot Rod Red scene 2026-05-23.
